registry.description: Docker registry base URL. If not provided, the DOCKER_REGISTRY environment variable is used.

buildArgs.description: Build arguments to pass to the Docker build command

skipLogin.description: Skip login to the Docker registry. Useful for CI/CD or development environments since the user should already be authenticated.

skipBuild.description: Skip (re)building the image before pushing; assumes it was already built and loaded. Set automatically when the build executor calls push, to avoid building twice.
